marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Bead `bob-cli-kd.3` is done and the final declaration is accepted.

Built the `bank-cli` phase: bare `bob bank` waiting queue (`list` with `-a`/`-m`), `report` with the full totals semantics (`-D`/`-m`/`-w`/`-y`, at most one period), and capture-style guarded writes `ensure` (month note + day heading, `-o`) and `ack` (IDs and/or `-D`, `-d` dry run). Human output follows the plan samples (queue, bars, heat strip, tabular amounts, `NO_COLOR`/pipe-safe); JSON is `schema_version: 1` with `unverified`/`untracked` account stubs. New modules: [model.rs](src/native/bank/model.rs), [list.rs](src/native/bank/list.rs), [report.rs](src/native/bank/report.rs), [dates.rs](src/native/bank/dates.rs), [ensure.rs](src/native/bank/ensure.rs), [ack.rs](src/native/bank/ack.rs), [status.rs](src/native/bank/status.rs); rewrote [cli.rs](src/native/bank/cli.rs) and extended [output.rs](src/native/bank/output.rs). Wired `BankAck`/`BankEnsure`/`BankList`/`BankReport` through [native.rs](src/native.rs), [runner.rs](src/runner.rs) (bare `bob bank` defaults to `list`), [catalog/table.rs](src/native/catalog/table.rs) (92→96 entries), and [completion](src/native/completion/tree.rs) with kinds decisions. Updated [docs/bank.md](docs/bank.md), [json-outputs.md](docs/reference/json-outputs.md), regenerated the CLI reference via `just docs-gen`.

Verified: `just lint` passes; 31 `native::bank` lib tests pass (new totals/list/report/ensure/ack/`BOB_NOW` cases); all 3549 CLI integration tests pass; manual end-to-end (ensure→type→list→report→ack, JSON, teaching empty, week/year, exit codes 2 on bad period/unknown ID) confirmed. Two failures reproduce identically on the clean base and were recorded as `PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP` notes, not fixed: the `capture_link_tasks` unreadable-notes assertion and five `docs-check` word-budget overruns in untouched mac-capture/plugin pages.
